facts.fact: The UGD's webinar deck of 11 June 2025 lists, among initiatives under way, the systematic registration of births, described as delivering a civil-status act with a unique identification number (NUI) for each newborn; it gives no count of acts or offices.
facts.system: Enregistrement systématique des naissances / Système d'État Civil (SIECM)

systems.system: Enregistrement systématique des naissances / Système d'État Civil (SIECM)
systems.owner: PRODIGY component 1, financed by the World Bank; presented by the Unité de Gouvernance Digitale
systems.tiers: shown as its own perimeter in the system diagram, receiving data from the IDMS; tiers not stated

systems.system: Système IDMS (orchestration, ABIS, NUI generator, IDVS, registre de population)
systems.platform: described as an open-source, open-standard system for unique identification; ABIS; IDVS module for authentication and eKYC
systems.tiers: offline biometric enrolment on kits loaded with NUI and biographic data by district; central deduplication and population register

systems.platform: chipless polycarbonate ID-1 card, laser personalised, with a QR code in W3C verifiable-credential format
systems.tiers: production target of 100,000 cards a day, with card production deconcentrated inside the country during the transition
household census attributing a unique identifier and a fokontany booklet to each household; its database feeds the enrolment kits
shown in the enrolment flow as a source for civil-status catch-up

systems.system: IDMS to Système d'État Civil data flow
systems.tiers: enrolment captures information for the état civil and sends data to the civil status system, which confirms or establishes the civil status before the NUI is activated

note: A procurement webinar on the biometric identity card; the civil registration system appears only as a linked initiative and a box in the architecture diagram, with no statement of how or where offices use it.
